mcq_fix.why: odd phrase 'as identified in the given classification'

mcq_fix.s: In the World Bank's income classification (July 2026), India is placed in which income group?
mcq_fix.why: odd phrase 'on the basis of the stated July 2026 data'

mcq_drop.why: non-standard term 'premature leapfrogging' (exam would say premature deindustrialisation)

pyq_bad.why: garbled: stray book header in stem (duplicate of y4d7c1584d89)

patterns: Most-asked one-liner: 'Indian economy is' -> Mixed; also developing vs underdeveloped and Father of Economics = Adam Smith (not Keynes).
APPSC uses 'most important cause of underdevelopment' (under-utilised manpower + resources) and 'NOT a main cause' (working efficiency).
Sector classification matching (Trade = service, water supply = industrial, fisheries = primary, GDP = CSO) and disguised unemployment = agriculture.
APPSC G1 used an Assertion-Reason on structural change in national income composition.
App MCQs add many current 2025-26 data items (GDP growth, AP GVA shares, World Bank bands) that PYQs do not test at this depth.
